chunks: My father (peace be upon him) said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to me from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fadl, from Ubayd ibn Zurara, from Abdullah ibn A'yan, who said: I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying:

When a man commits fornication, the Shaytan enters his member, and both of them act together. The semen is from both of them, and the child is created from both of them, and he becomes a partner of the Shaytan.
ai.seo_question: How does Shaytan participate in human fornication according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Thawab al-A'mal, Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration to illustrate the metaphysical reality of Zina, where Shaytan does not merely tempt but actively co-creates the offspring through the man's organ. This concept of 'Shirk al-Shaytan' (partnership with Satan) underscores that the resulting child carries a spiritual imprint of the devil, linking physical lineage to spiritual corruption. The narration serves as a theological basis for understanding how major sins can alter the ontological status of the individual and their progeny.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 4.  It  is  narrated  that  Imam  Muhammad  Baqir  (a.s.)  said, “When a person commits fornication, he is not alone and the  Shaitaan accompanies  him. Both of them  commit this sin together. The semen is of one person only but the child belongs to both of them. Hence he is a partner of Shaitaan.”
